tldr: The change adds branded e-mail layouts to Email inboxes. Admins set an account layout and an inbox override through the API. Replies use the layout when the feature flag is on.
goal: Email inboxes send replies without the company's own brand layout.

story.heading: Inboxes gain a branded e-mail layout
story.body: Email inboxes save and read their own branded layout template.

story.heading: E-mail delivery renders replies in the layout
story.body: Replies and transcripts use the branded layout when the feature flag is on.

story.heading: REST API reads and sets the layouts
story.body: Admins read and set the account layout and the inbox overrides by API.

story.heading: Admins save the account layout over the API
story.body: The API checks the feature flag, then saves or clears the account layout.

story.heading: Email templates gain an inbox scope
story.body: Each template row has an account scope, an inbox scope, or the installation scope.

story.heading: Branded layouts wrap Email inbox replies
story.body: Admins set the layouts, and the mailer renders replies inside them.

components.summary: Adds endpoints to read and set the account layout and inbox overrides.
Saves each inbox layout and checks if the layout applies to it.
Renders replies and transcripts in the branded layout when the flag is on.
Adds the inbox scope to templates and turns the flag off for existing accounts.

decisions.title: Scope templates by account and inbox in one table
decisions.why: One table lets the resolver find the account layout and the inbox layout the same way.
decisions.alternative: Store inbox layouts in a separate table

decisions.title: Gate the layout behind the account feature flag
decisions.why: The feature is disabled by default and an admin turns it on per account.
decisions.alternative: Enable the layout for all accounts

decisions.title: Expose the layouts through the API only
decisions.why: Admins set the layouts by API calls, with no dashboard screen in this change.

flows.title: Reply to a conversation by e-mail
Save an account branded e-mail layout

entities.name: email_templates
fields: ~ unique index per scope: installation, account, inbox
